step.para: If you need to restart the cluster services manually, follow these steps to minimize resource downtime:
If the cluster uses &dlm;, stop the &dlm; resource and any &dlm;-dependent resources before putting the cluster into maintenance mode:
Use --wait to make sure the resources have really stopped before the command returns.
Put the cluster into maintenance mode:

In this state, the cluster stops monitoring all resources. This allows the services managed by the resources to keep running while the cluster restarts. However, be aware that the resources won't be highly available while in maintenance mode.
Restart the cluster services on all nodes:
Check the status of the cluster:
The nodes will have the status UNCLEAN (offline), but will soon change to Online.
When the nodes are back online, put the cluster back into normal operation:
If you stopped &dlm; and any &dlm;-dependent resources, you can start them again now:
